Hi Marissa —

Thanks — I can do Tue Nov 3 at 15:00 PST. Quick heads up on timing: I have an existing commitment through Jan 8 and would prefer a start week of Jan 12 or Jan 19 (Jan 19 is safest if paperwork takes longer).

A couple of questions I glanced at in the draft:
- Can the equity vesting start date be anchored to my actual start date rather than the offer date?
- Is there flexibility on the relocation payout timing (pay on acceptance vs. after relocation)?

I’m happy to discuss these on the call; I don’t plan to redline immediately. Also cc’ing mobility team contact here for relocation details: mobility-relocate@relomgmt.com.

Thanks,

Marissa / Jonas —

Thanks for looping me in. Jonas and I discussed the start flexibility: we can be firm on the band and base but flexible on the official start week — Jan 19 is acceptable if Samira needs extra runway. For equity, we prefer vesting to begin on the employee’s official start date; suggest we explicitly state that in the DocuSign placeholder and avoid backdating.

On relocation: please route the mobility questions to the mobility vendor (cc’d). If they confirm payout terms are standard (payable upon receipt of relocation receipts within 60 days), we’re fine. If the candidate requests acceptance-triggered payout, escalate to me for approval.

If Samira brings up any material redlines on the call, please capture them and send to me and Marissa for a quick review — I can approve safe-for-offer clarifications; anything changing comp/equity requires an exec sign-off.

Laura

Hi Samira —

Great — confirmed for Tue Nov 3, 15:00 PST (Zoom invite sent separately). Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned ahead of the call: 

1) Start-week: we’ll aim to lock in Jan 19 as the official start-week placeholder in the DocuSign. If paperwork completes earlier we’ll move it earlier with your okay.
2) DocuSign: I will prepare an envelope immediately after our call. That envelope will contain the offer PDF with the Jan 19 placeholder and a short "relocation FAQ" PDF. Expect: DocuSign_Envelope_Placeholder.link after the call.
3) Equity vesting: per Laura, vesting will commence on official start date. I will add the explicit line in the offer that says "vesting start date will be the employee’s first day of work."
4) Relocation payout timing: mobility team (cc’d) will confirm policy; if candidate requests immediate acceptance-triggered payout I will escalate to Laura for decision.

If you’d like to surface any specific redlines during our call, mention them verbally and I’ll record them and route to Laura/Jonas for fast-turn review. If there are no redlines we’ll send the DocuSign for e-sign on the same day.
